Aapka order ORD-22002 delivered dikha raha hai. Belt missing hone ke liye main aapse maafi chahta hoon. Maine missing belt ke liye Rs 1,500 ka partial refund initiate kar diya hai, jo 3-5 working days mein aapke original payment method par credit ho jayega. 

Kya main aapki kisi aur cheez mein madad kar sakta hoon?
